text:
Clara: Quick thread on NovaSquad case + launch flow. Theyre happy to do a short case study and a product demo. Need a signed release and copy approvals before we push out any promo.

Priya: Great. They reported a 4x batch speedup on their nightly job and ~22% lower inference cost. Let's confirm exact phrasing and whether we can use logos.

Marco (NovaSquad): Confirmed. We'll share the measurement sheet and were ok with logo use. Prefer an embargo until our sales kickoff next Friday.

Izzy (Legal): Paste the proposed hero quote here and attach the benchmark file. We'll prepare the release with an embargo clause. Also request that translations require customer sign-off if we localize.

Clara: Draft hero: "NovaSquad experienced a 4x batch processing speedup and reduced inference spend by ~22% during our integration."

Izzy (Legal): '4x' and '~22%' are fine if the spreadsheet is attached. Add a data-source sentence: "Benchmarking measured during a two-week integration test; data provided by NovaSquad." I'll add the embargo for the sales kickoff date.

Marco (NovaSquad): Uploading spreadsheet now: https://files.novasquad/reports/redwood-integration-14d.csv (access: collaborators). We approve the quote but please use 'approximately 22%' publicly.

Eli (SalesOps): When published, route demo interest to NovaSquad AEs and our strategic-accounts SDR team. I'll create the SFDC campaign and webhook; needs campaign ID before publish.

Priya: Noted. Plan: 1) Legal releases + signed pdf, 2) copy approvals thread, 3) SFDC campaign created, 4) assets uploaded to CDN. Target soft publish the Monday after their sales kickoff (to respect embargo).

assets-bot: Release templates: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/customer-release-standard.pdf 

Izzy (Legal): Uploaded a redline with embargo and data-source phrasing. Link: https://legal.redwood/redlines/3991234567. Please confirm signatory on NovaSquad's side before we finalize.

Marco (NovaSquad): Signing now. I'll have our VP of Engineering sign and I'll upload the signed PDF by EOD.

Clara: Once signed, Priya will post draft copy for one quick round of edits. Keep the blog short, highlight the benchmark, and include a CTA to book a demo (routing to their AE).

Eli (SalesOps): I'll share the SFDC campaign ID in the approvals thread once created. Also will set an automation to tag any demo leads as "nova-cs-interest".

Priya: Draft copy ETA tomorrow 10am PT. Will include social teasers and suggested tweet variations.

Izzy (Legal): Mark as resolved after the signed release uploaded. :white_check_mark:

Marco (NovaSquad): Signed release uploaded to the shared folder. Looking forward to the interview. :smile:

Clara: Perf. Internal checklist: pre-call 15 min before interview, record session, one internal review of quotes, then publish schedule locked after embargo lifts.

Priya: Draft posted. Please review and react with :thumbsup: for approval or comment inline.

Eli (SalesOps): SFDC campaign created: CAMPAIGN-8042. Webhook linked to demo form. Will post details in the copy thread.

Clara: Thanks team. Moving to approvals.

Marco (NovaSquad): Approved copy and social. Happy to join the demo event.
